statement: theorem expected_pathLearnerLoss_succ (A : List Bool → ℝ) (T : ℕ) : pathExpectation (T + 1) (pathLearnerLoss A) = pathExpectation T (pathLearnerLoss A) + pathExpectation T (fun h => (1 - polyaNext h) * (A h)^2 + polyaNext h * (A h - 1)^2)
